context_visible: Aerial view of an industrial area with multiple buildings featuring blue and grey roofs.
A large, unpaved lot in the center contains scattered debris, piles of materials, and construction equipment.
A yellow crane arm extends across the lot.
A row of trees separates the lot from a road with parked cars.
A white car is visible on the road in the lower right.
Piles of curved metal sheets are stacked in the foreground.

The white car on the road is visible in both images, anchoring the location.
The row of trees and the adjacent building with the grey roof are consistent across both views.
perception.description: An aerial view shows an industrial site with a large, cluttered lot containing debris, construction materials, and a yellow crane. The lot is bordered by a tree-lined road with parked cars and surrounded by buildings with blue and grey roofs. A white car is visible on the road. The scene appears to be a construction or demolition site.
evidence_visible: Close-up of the central lot showing a yellow crane arm extending horizontally.
Piles of mixed debris, including blue tarps and metal scraps.
A small yellow vehicle, possibly a loader, is visible near the bottom right of the lot.
The white car on the road is clearly visible.
The grey-roofed building and the row of trees are clearly visible.
unclear: The exact nature of the debris (e.g., construction waste, demolition rubble).
